messages:
sarah_support: FYI — CSM escalated: A/B rollout dashboard shows Variant B with ~2x assignments compared to what our feature flag dashboard reports. Customer says users are seeing unexpected behavior. Can we triage? :eyes:

james_eng: Can you paste the dashboard screenshot and any customer repro steps? Is this across all time ranges or a recent spike?

sarah_support: Screenshot uploaded to thread (link) — they say counts diverged starting ~yesterday 10:00 UTC. They pulled the 'assignment_count_by_variant' chart and got B=12,345 A=6,100 but feature flag service reports A=11,900 B=6,545.

maya_product: Possible rollout config mismatch? We rolled variant mapping change last week (flip naming for legacy flags). Tagging @eli_analytics to check ETL/metric mapping.

eli_analytics: Looking now. Quick check: aggregation pipeline joins events.user_id -> assignments.variant_label. I see a mapping transform that normalizes labels: `variant_label = IF(flag_value == 1, 'B', 'A')` — that was inverted in the transform on 2026-01-14 during a migration. Running a verification query now.

eli_analytics: Repro SQL I ran against analytics replica (sanitized):
```sql
SELECT variant_label, count(DISTINCT user_id) as users
FROM rollout_assignments
WHERE rollout_id = 'rl_739' AND event_time >= '2026-01-13'
GROUP BY variant_label
ORDER BY users DESC;
```

eli_analytics: The raw events show flag_value 1 -> intended to be 'A' but transform maps to 'B'. That explains the swap.

james_eng: Thanks. Do we know when that transform got deployed? Any deploy logs? @deploybot can you show recent ETL deploys?

deploybot: ETL-pipeline service deployed commit c9d2e3 on 1763420000 (2026-01-14 03:20 UTC) by ori_data. Release notes: "normalization: standardize flag value->label mapping". No rollout flag noted.

ops_oncall: There's also a backlog on the events consumer from yesterday; some days of data were reprocessed during backfill. If the transform was wrong and we reprocessed, dashboards would show swapped counts retroactively.

maya_product: Oof. That would affect historical charts. Need to assess exposure and notify customers. What's the scope?

eli_analytics: Quick scope: affected rollout ids where transform applied and where flag_value was used (legacy flags). I ran this to list impacted rollouts:
```sql
SELECT rollout_id, sum(case when flag_value=1 then 1 else 0 end) as ones_count
FROM raw_flag_events
WHERE event_time >= '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY rollout_id
HAVING ones_count > 1000
LIMIT 50;
```
Found ~12 rollouts with significant volume.

james_eng: Mitigation plan: 1) Fix transform in ETL to use correct mapping. 2) Reprocess only the affected partitions with corrected transform. 3) In console, mark affected dashboards as "under investigation" and add note. 4) Notify impacted customers with details and ETA.

eli_analytics: I can push corrected transform as hotfix. Will run a dry-run reprocess on a small date range to validate counts flip back. Expected wall time for reprocess of one day for one rollout ~30m.

sarah_support: I'll draft a customer message template for impacted accounts. Need clear wording: "We discovered a data processing issue that caused variant labels to be swapped in the A/B dashboard; UI and feature flag state were unaffected. We're reprocessing analytics and will update with ETA."

maya_product: Also schedule a postmortem with data team — how did the transform change slip through review? Add a regeneration job to detect label inversion (sanity check).

ops_oncall: Running reprocess now (dry run) for rollout rl_739 for 2026-01-13..2026-01-15. I'll post results.

ops_oncall: Dry-run complete — counts now match feature flag service for sample: A=11,908 B=6,512. No downstream errors.

eli_analytics: Rolling corrected transform to staging ETL and queuing partition reprocessing for all affected rollouts. I'll open a runbook with exact commands we used.

james_eng: Once reprocess finishes, let's do an end-to-end check: compare dashboard values vs feature-flag service for top 10 rollouts. Automate a periodic job to assert delta < 1% for critical rollouts.

sarah_support: Customer update sent to SRE and CSMs for the impacted customers. Template approved by legal.

maya_product: Nice work. Add note in console changelog: "Data correction applied for swapped variant labels affecting historical A/B assignments (2026-01-14). Dashboards reflect corrected data after reprocessing)."

eli_analytics: Reprocess started for all 12 rollouts at 1763505200. Expected completion in ~4 hours. I'll post when done.

ops_oncall: Reprocess finished successfully at 1763507600. Post-checks show most rollouts now within expected deltas.

james_eng: Closing loop: push the sanity assertion into nightly jobs, add an alert if any rollout has >5% label delta vs feature flag service.

sarah_support: Customer replies: "Thanks — we can confirm the numbers now match our internal logs. Appreciate the quick fix." :white_check_mark:

maya_product: Postmortem assigned to data infra, due EOD Friday. Good job team. :tada:
